## Checklist

- [ ] I ran the relevant core, ML, and/or end-to-end tests and recorded the results above.
- [ ] I added or updated focused tests for behavior changes where appropriate.
- [ ] I updated the README or relevant documentation for behavior, configuration, or limit changes.
- [ ] I did not claim that a file or depicted scene is real; wording preserves the scanner's documented limits.
- [ ] I reported negative, inconclusive, and contradictory results and did not hide known limitations.
- [ ] I did not train on evaluation data or use a fresh confirmation set for training, calibration, or model selection.
- [ ] I did not create or test with manipulated media of a real identifiable person; manipulated examples use synthetic faces only.
- [ ] I did not add private, intimate, unlicensed, or unnecessary personal data to the repository.
- [ ] I kept research data and raw experimental outputs under the git-ignored `research/` directory.
- [ ] I expect all GitHub Actions jobs (`test`, `e2e`, `test-ml`, and `docker`) to pass.
